findings.claim: Five of seven decider seats converge on JNJ. Convergence is only a signal if the reads were independent; on a modest composite and ordinary participation, five-seat agreement may be shared-anchor agreement on the same structure read rather than five distinct methods. Each seat owes the one field its own method leaned on that the others did not.

findings.claim: Utilities cluster: five nominated names from one sector, and every one sits under a falling higher-timeframe MA stack (ma_50 below ma_200).
